newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares seen jumpy, electricity sector soft.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares seen jumpy, electricity sector soft.

text.p: Erratic trade in Chilean stocks was seen at the opening, with heavyweight electricity shares falling on Monday's Supreme Court ruling in favor of the government in a dispute over prices, said traders.
"The market will take it as a negative surprise, as the appeal court had ruled in favor of the companies," said David Hurd, head of research at Merrill Lynch.
"There is likely to be short-term weakness in Chilectra and Enersis."
But the impact of the ruling should be brief as there was little difference between the government's planned price cuts and the proposals put forward by the companies, said traders.
Regulators were said to be wanting to cut rates by 10 percent, while utilities had offered to reduce them by around 6-8 percent.
Investors will also be keeping a keen eye on first quarter earnings which must be released by Wednesday.
The 40-share .IPSA index closed down 0.06 percent Monday at 117.04 points. ((-- Margaret Orgill, Santiago newsroom, 562-699-5595 x212))
